text:
maria: Heads up — noticed shadow-training invites aren't going out for some candidates. Looks like ATS webhook 'inviter' sometimes null. Anyone else seeing this? Example payload: ```{"candidate_id":"C123","inviter":null,"panel":["jess","owen"]}```

owen: seeing same on scheduler logs — 2026-03-20T14:02:11Z: webhook deliver OK but mapping fails. suspect ATS field rename.

jess: workaround: export pending invites CSV and run quick_add_invites.py to seed panelists. I'll do it for today's cohort unless devs fix.

devon: I pushed a mapping fix to staging — changed inviter -> created_by in webhook parser. Diff: ```- inviter = payload.get('inviter')
+ inviter = payload.get('created_by')``` Can someone test staging?

maria: thanks. I'll pull staging and run replay on the missing 8 candidates. Do we need a migration script for archived webhooks?

ats-bot: replay job queued (job_id=87422) by maria. status: queued.

owen: quick note — when inviter is null we should fallback to 'recruiter_id' before defaulting to 'system'. Could we add fallback to parser?

devon: added fallback in PR #421. Will auto-default to recruiter_id -> created_by -> 'system'. Running unit tests.

jess: FYI recruiting ops, I'm prepping a short 'how we respond to webhook rename' doc and a 10-min huddle for interviewers tomorrow 9:30 — covers manual CSV and new expectations.

maria: great. After staging confirms I'll run replay and close the incident. Also can we log which invites were bounced so we can email panelists directly?

devon: replay done in staging, tests pass. ETA deploy to prod ~30m.

ats-bot: deploy to prod scheduled, deploy-bot started, tracking id=deploy-993.

maria: deployed and replays processed; confirmed 8 invites sent. Thanks all. Can someone add retro notes to #incidents and tag recruiting-ops? :tada:

owen: adding retro now. suggest adding schema versioning to webhook contract so renames surface earlier.
